task.title: Inputting the 47 - EI ERB - Earnings limit exceeded for the four week period disentitlement (D47)

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is an outstanding registration number:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 11.

If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the claim is active or terminated:

ul.li: If the claim is active, go to step 13.
If the claim is terminated and cannot be reactivated, go to step 21.
If the claim is terminated but can be reactivated, select the appropriate BPCon the Dormant tab, select Reactivate . Go to step 12.

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if there is a WI for the task:

ul.li: If no, hold the task for 24 hours.

If yes, move the WI to Pending as follows:
Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Input the disentitlement.”
Bring forward date: Enter the next business day.
When the WI moves to the current workload, go to step 13.

step.cmd: In NWS, determine which of the following situations applies:

ul.li: If an existing D47 must be modified, go to step 14.
If an existing D47 must be rescinded and a new D47 input, go to step 15.
If an existing D47 must be rescinded and no new D47 must be input, go to step 17 and ignore the mention of On day 2 .
If a new D47 must be input, go to step 19.

step.cmd: Determine if the start and end dates of the disentitlements must be modified:

ul.li: If the start and end dates must be modified, go to step 15.
If only the end dates must be modified, go to step 18.

step.cmd: On day one, in FTS, select the Disqualifications/Disentitlements (M161) transaction to impose the D47 with the correct dates as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select - Add .
Disentitlement: Select 47 - Undeclared earnings - EI ERB earnings limit exceeded for the four week period .
Start date: Enter the disentitlement start date.
End date: Enter the disentitlement end date.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earning and employment .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if there is a WI for the task:

ul.li: If no, hold the task for 24 hours.

If yes, move the WI to Pending as follows:
Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Correct disentitlement input — original disentitlement will be rescinded on day 2.”
Bring forward date: Enter the next business day.

step.cmd: On day 2, in FTS, select the Disqualifications/Disentitlements link to remove the original D47 as follows:

ul.li: Select the disentitlement that must be rescinded.
Select Modify .

When the Disqualification/Disentitlements (M161) transaction opens, rescind the D47 as follows:
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Rescind .
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts-entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earning and employment .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To complete the registration number, select C - Yes .
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No .
Select Update .
Go to step 20.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Disqualifications/Disentitlements (M161) link to modify the end date of the D47 as follows:

ul.li: Select the disentitlement that must be modified.
Select Modify .

When the Disqualification/Disentitlements (M161) transaction opens, modify the D47 as follows:
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select T - Terminate/Modify .
End date: Enter the correct disentitlement end date.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts-entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earning and employment .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To complete the registration number, select C - Yes.
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No.
Select Update .
Go to step 20.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Disqualifications/Disentitlements (M161) transaction and impose a D47 for the appropriate period as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select - Add.
Disentitlement: Select 47 - EI ERB - Earnings limit exceeded for the four week period .
Start date: Enter the disentitlement start date.
End date: Enter the disentitlement end date.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earning and employment .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No.
To clear the registration number, C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Determine if a disentitlement for another 4-week period must be input or modified:

ul.li: If yes, return to step 13.
If no, go to step 46, then return to the initial task or complete the WI.

step.cmd: Determine the blocked claim’s CS by reviewing the Blocked Status column on the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If 2 - Not blocked is displayed, return to step 11.
If 1 - Updateable is displayed , go to step 22.
If any other CS is displayed, go to step 43.

step.cmd: Review the Blocked Action Pending column:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, go to step 23.
If all rows are blank, go to step 25.

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if there is a WI for the task:

ul.li: If no, hold the task for 24 hours.

If yes, move the WI to Pending as follows:
Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Waiting for an updateable CS in BCS.”
Bring forward date: Enter the next business day.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, in FTS, review the Blocked Action Pending column on the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, return to step 23.
If all rows are blank, go to step 25.

step.cmd: In NWS, determine which of the following situations applies:

ul.li: If an existing D47 must be modified, go to step 26.
If an existing D47 must be rescinded and a new D47 input, go to step 27.
If an existing D47 must be rescinded and no new D47 must be input, go to step 31.
If a new D47 must be input, go to step 39.

step.cmd: Determine if the start and end dates of the disentitlements must be modified:

ul.li: If the start and end dates must be modified, go to step 27.
If only the end dates must be modified, go to step 35.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the BPC you want to update from the Blocked Status column. When the Blocked Claim screen opens, complete the following fields:

ul.li: Action required: Select Claim update .
Agreed deduction: Select (100%) Blocked claim system default .
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No to leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions.
Select Update .

step.cmd: On the Disentitlements tab, input the D47 as follows:

ul.li:
On the first line:
Action: Select A - Add .
Type: Select 47 - EI ERB – Earnings limit exceeded for the four week period .
Start date: Enter the disentitlement start date, if necessary.
End date: Enter the disentitlement end date.

On the second line:
Action: Select X - Rescind .
Type: Select 47 - EI ERB - Earnings limit exceeded for the four week period.
Start date: Enter the disentitlement start date.
End date: Enter the disentitlement end date.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earning and employment .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Select Update .

step.cmd: On the Pending Transactions tab, review the transaction:

ul.li: If one or all the transactions are incorrect, go to step 30.
If the transactions are correct, select Close and go to step 46. Then return to the initial task or complete the WI.

step.cmd: Delete the incorrect transaction as follows:

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the incorrect transaction.
Select Update .
Return to step 28.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the BPC to update from the Blocked Status column. When the Blocked Claim screen opens, complete the following fields:

ul.li: Action required: Select Claim update .
Agreed deduction: Select (100%) Blocked claim system default .
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: On Disentitlements tab, rescind the D47 as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select X - Rescind .
Type: Select 47 - EI ERB – Earnings limit exceeded for the four week period .
Start date: Enter the disentitlement start date.
End date: Enter the disentitlement end date.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earning and employment .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Select Update .

step.cmd: On the Pending Transactions tab, review the transaction:

ul.li: If the transaction shown is incorrect, go to step 34.
If the transaction shown is correct, select Close and return to the initial task or complete the WI.

step.cmd: Delete the incorrect transaction as follows:

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the incorrect transaction.
Select Update .
Return to step 32.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the BPC you want to update from the Blocked Status column. When the Blocked Claim screen opens, complete the following fields:

ul.li: Action required: Select Claim update .
Agreed deduction: Select (100%) Blocked claim system default .
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: On the Disentitlements tab, terminate the D47 as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select T - Terminate .
Type: Select 47 - EI ERB - Earnings limit exceeded for the four week period .
Start date: Enter the disentitlement start date.
End date: Enter the disentitlement end date.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earning and employment .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Select Update .

step.cmd: On the Pending Transactions tab, review the transaction:

ul.li: If the transaction shown is incorrect, go to step 38.
If the transaction shown is correct, select Close and go to step 46. Then, return to the initial task or complete the WI.

step.cmd: Delete the incorrect transaction as follows:

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the incorrect transaction.
Select Update .
Return to step 36.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the BPC you want to update from the Blocked Status column. When the Blocked Claim screen opens, complete the following fields:

ul.li: Action required: Select Claim update .
Agreed deduction: Select (100%) Blocked claim system default .
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: On the Disentitlements tab, input the D47 as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select A - Add .
Type: Select 47 - EI ERB - Earnings limit exceeded for the four week period .
Start date: Enter the disentitlement start date.
End date: Enter the disentitlement end date.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earning and employment .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Select Update .

step.cmd: On the Pending Transactions tab, review the transaction:

ul.li: If the transaction shown is incorrect, go to step 42.
If the transaction shown is correct, select Close and go to step 46. Then, return to the initial task or complete the WI.

step.cmd: Delete the incorrect transaction as follows:

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the incorrect transaction.
Select Update .
Return to step 40.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earning and employment .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the claim requiring the disentitlement to be input.
Work item: Select 91 - Overpayment .
Work type: Select 2 - Non-misrepresentation .
Earnings to be allocated: Leave this field blank.
Remarks line 1: Type “[Add, terminate, or rescind] D47 from w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].”
Remarks line 2–4: If there are additional disentitlement periods that require input or modification, type “D47 from w/c [XXXX-X] to w/c [XXXX-X].”
Remarks line 5: Enter your name and telephone number.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the F-00-00-00 letter. Unless specified, select the most appropriate option for each of the following attributes:

ul.li: Opening Sentence (2466): Select Blank .
Text – Free Text (1612): Type: Callout
